response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves treatment for an acute injury (ankle sprain) that occurred during a trip. Clause A4.1 covers medical expenses abroad for treatment resulting from an acute illness or injury during the trip. There is no indication of a pre-existing condition or planned treatment, so clause A5.1 does not apply. The treatment provided (ice, compression, elevation, and medication) is considered appropriate and necessary under the policy."}
